title: Prove how Project Intent applies a newer revision

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: Project Intent applies a newer revision through the IntentPerspective composition

Verdict: Caught. Checked revision 89401655ab84526ec5256e9fbe503dffcf9656f3 in an isolated scratch worktree.
Promise (Key example 1): two new revisions arrive while the reader has Project Intent open in the real dashboard; one notice is offered, and Show latest applies the latest revision in the same reading.
Fault: in dashboard/src/IntentPerspective.tsx IntentBody, the work passed to ProjectIntentReading was frozen to the first observed work.
Independent witness (temporary built-app journey, removed): baseline passed; under the fault the notice "New revision available — showing d4d4d4d" never rendered; restored passed.
Maintained checks (npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- intent/intent-revision --workers=2): baseline 9/9; under the fault intent-revision-planning-only.spec.ts:59 (revision notice visible) failed, intent-revision-update-outcomes.spec.ts:59 and intent-revision-update-boundaries.spec.ts:78 timed out on Show latest; intent-revision-notice.spec.ts and the five mounted cases passed; restored 9/9.
Limit: no maintained built-app case completes a successful Show latest through IntentPerspective; this probe gives no evidence about a composition fault that keeps the offer but breaks a successful apply.
Next proof action: no repair for this fault. To protect the composed successful apply, probe a fault that keeps the offer but breaks the apply, or add the success transition to an existing built-app journey.
Cost: about 80 s test runtime; elapsed 266942 ms; scratch worktree removed.

Wrap-up disposition (checked revision 89401655a): the probed fault fails the ordinary frontend test entry, so nothing is queued for it. The composed successful-apply gap matches queued work and is added to SEED-413#renovate-later-dashboard-frontend-unit-tests's scope. That story owns the four remaining composed built-app revision cases and must keep a successful Show latest through IntentPerspective when they move.
